events.name: Archivist Capy
events.text: A sudden throughput decline to 89% of baseline was traced to a canary rollout that reduced the GPU power limit on node np-9addff51-23 from 700W to 450W, triggering SwPowerCap throttling and ~13% SM clock reduction. Reverting the power limit and rolling back the daemonset restored performance to 100% of baseline within minutes.

declared.detail: gpu-power-policy v2 canary cut power limit 700W -> 450W on all 8 GPUs at 02:14:07Z, causing SwPowerCap throttle, ~13.5% lower SM clocks (1704-1711 MHz vs 1971 median), and compute slowdown on ranks 176-183 (4.50-4.53s vs 3.55s median); synchronous TP=8/PP=4/DP=16 propagates the slow node to the whole job

report.title: Throughput drop on yuzu-70b-pretrain caused by GPU power limit reduction
report.summary: A sudden throughput decline to 89% of baseline was traced to a canary rollout that reduced the GPU power limit on node np-9addff51-23 from 700W to 450W, triggering SwPowerCap throttling and ~13% SM clock reduction. Reverting the power limit and rolling back the daemonset restored performance to 100% of baseline within minutes.
report.root_cause: gpu-power-policy v2 canary reduced power limit on np-9addff51-23, causing SwPowerCap throttling and compute slowdown on ranks 176-183
report.proof: Counterfactual removal of node np-9addff51-23 explains 95.6% of the slowdown; pre-canary snapshot shows 700W/1978MHz with no throttle, while post-canary shows 450W/1545MHz with SwPowerCap; rank timings and SM clocks match the throttling pattern
report.fix: Reset power limit on np-9addff51-23 and revert the gpu-power-policy v2 daemonset rollout to restore 700W limit
report.verification: 200 training steps from 02:20:34Z to 02:35:19Z achieved 473.6k tokens/s (100.3% of baseline) with step times p50=4.40s, p95=4.45s and zero new errors, confirming full recovery
